example.title: Connie's Hair Salon, Broadway (John Margolies Roadside America photo)

brief: Two-storey brick commercial front whose ground floor keeps three big round brick arches: the outer two hold arched display windows over a brick bulkhead, the centre an entry with a painted fanlight sign. Painted white pilasters with long blue inset panels, a thin roll-up awning, window lettering; an open wooden stair climbs the side wall to the upper flats. Parking meters at the curb; a narrow frame-front shop with a big painted letter sign next door completes the lot.
